rows.title: Offer for sale
rows.summary: The President of India, acting through the Ministry of Heavy Industries, Government of India has informed the Exchange about an announcement with respect to offer for sale through Stock Exchange Mechanism for sale upto 10,44,61,901 Equity shares of face value of INR 2/- each of Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited. Date and time of the opening of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: February 11, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: February 11, 2026 at 3:30 p.m.; Date and time of the opening of the offer for Retail Investors: February 12, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Retail Investors: February 12, 2026 at 3:30 p.m. The Sale shall continue to take place on a separate window of the Stock Exchanges commencing at 9:15 a.m. and shall close at 3:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on the same date. The Floor Price for the Offer shall be INR 254/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Fifty Four Only)
